review_evidence: README describes a neural theorem-proving tutorial whose first part implements Lean next-step suggestion and proof search.

The primary Lean files implement LLM suggestion/extraction support and contain executable theorem-proving examples used by the tutorial; they therefore encode proof-assistant interfaces and examples, not merely generated notebook output.
Tutorial/example provenance alone is not a hard-exclusion criterion under FILTER-011; no stronger lossless selector was established.
summary: Retain the neural-theorem-proving Lean support and formal examples used by the tutorial.
